requirement._comments_req_Receivers: conscious only (CharaReq defaults) - an unconscious character is carried instead (com_interaction_carry)

list._comments: 携带: the player picks up the current target who cannot move (unconscious, immobilized, time stopped), lifted out of the bed / sofa keeping them. One at a time; they move with the player and are only put down through 安放 (com_player_putDown). Dialogue tab like 同行 (dialogueOnly): it rebuilds the receiver from the live current target, the main panel's player COM buttons keep the target they were built with. Variant 0 = time stopped target (first, so it wins). Docs/Furniture/Plan_FurnitureOccupancy.md §3

requirement._comments_req_Receivers: cannot move but not locked (unconscious / immobilized, not restrained / jailed) is checked in code - FurnitureOccupancyUtility.CanBeCarried

list._comments: 安放: folder - clicking lists every bed / sofa in the room that can take the carried character (scr_panel_COMmanager.LoadPutDownPanel), each a com_furniture_putDown package. Never executed itself.

one 安放 choice: the player lays the carried receiver on this bed / sofa, which keeps them (soft container). Built per furniture by FurnitureOccupancyUtility.MakePutDownPackage, not offered by any furniture's givesJob.

安放 choice 'put down here': the carried is set down standing where the player is (no furniture) - only when they can stand: conscious and able to move but for a time stop (FurnitureOccupancyUtility.ValidateCarryRules). Unconscious / immobilized: bed or sofa only. Built by FurnitureOccupancyUtility.MakePutDownHerePackage on the player's command job, listed first in the 安放 panel; not tagged player (never in the main panel itself).

list._comment: Player-only. ActionPackage_GoToSchedule (extends ActionPackage_PathTo) resolves the target from the player's current hour (party gathering > schedule faction > home) and renames itself _work/_booking/_home. timeScale is unused - duration comes from the path.

Player-only contextual Work button (Docs/PlayerSchedule/Plan_PlayerSchedule.md). ActionPackage_Work resolves the current work shift: no shift / no command / no furniture -> invalid; no work furniture in the current room -> 'go to' (PathTo trip, renamed _goto); otherwise 'work as' (_work) - the click launches one valid scheduled work command on that furniture instead. The tooltip lists every work command of the shift. timeScale is unused.

requirements._comment: all interaction commands have a default interaction Energy cost that'll get added when executing package. Costs are deduced even if COM request failed.
requirements._commen2: interaction or not is getting detected on execution and it depends on doer and receiver state
